DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メールアドレスの変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Gusto mong palitan ang email address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メールが来ないので、新しいものに変えたいです。今のアドレスが間違っていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未着でアドレス誤りと思い変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi dumarating ang email, kaya gusto kong palitan. Sa tingin ko mali ang kasalukuyang address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais palitan dahil walang dumarating at inaakalang mali ang address. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 登録の表記と、受信の設定を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay nating tiyakin ang nakarehistrong baybay at mga setting ng pagtanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 登録は合っています。他のメールは届きますが、銀行からの案内だけ見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表記一致で他メールは受信できると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tama ang rehistro. Dumarating ang iba, pero abiso lamang ng bangko ang hindi makita.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na tugma ang baybay at natatanggap ang ibang email. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知の対象や現在の状態を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng tauhan ang saklaw ng abiso at kalagayan ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。アドレスを変えれば必ず直ると思わず、今の設定を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更で解消保証と思わず現設定の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap. Gusto kong malaman ang kasalukuyang setting, hindi isipin na siguradong aayos kapag pinalitan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling ng pagsusuri sa setting nang hindi ipinagpapalagay na tiyak ang solusyon sa pagpapalit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最近、ご自身で変更した設定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: May setting ka bang binago kamakailan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内メールを止める項目を選びました。ただ、必要な連絡も全部止まったかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内停止操作と影響範囲未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pinili kong ihinto ang mga email ng impormasyon. Pero hindi ko alam kung pati mahalagang tawag-pansin ay lahat nahinto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagpapatigil sa impormasyon at hindi pa tiyak ang saklaw ng epekto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設定の範囲を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itatanong sa tauhan ang saklaw ng setting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。必要な連絡と案内メールを分けて確認し、希望する受取方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要連絡と案内の設定を分け受取方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Gusto kong hiwalay na suriin ang mahalagang komunikasyon at impormasyon at ikonsulta ang gusto kong pagtanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang pagtanggap nang hiwalay ang mahalagang komunikasyon at impormasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。登録アドレスと通知設定を調べてから、変更が必要な項目をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Susuriin muna ang rehistrong address at setting, saka ipapakita ang kailangang baguhin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お菓子を配るためにお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Naghahanap ka ba ng meryendang ipamimigay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、六人に渡します。この六枚入りなら、一人ずつ未開封のまま渡せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六人へ未開封で渡すため六枚入りが合うか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, para sa anim. Kung anim ang piraso nito, maibibigay ko bang tig-isa nang hindi binubuksan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung ang anim na piraso ay angkop sa anim na taong tatanggap nang hindi bukas. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この教材の商品は二枚ずつ一袋で、三袋入りです。枚数と包装の数は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa produkto sa araling ito, dalawa bawat supot at tatlong supot lahat. Magkaiba ang piraso at pakete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六枚なら六袋だと思っていました。これでは未開封の袋は三人分ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚ずつ三袋で六包装ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko anim na piraso ay anim na supot. Tatlong tao lamang pala ang makatatanggap ng hindi bukas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyaking dalawa bawat supot, tatlo lahat, hindi anim na pakete. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋を開けて一枚ずつ分ける方法もありますが、未開封で渡したいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maaari ring buksan at hatiin, pero gusto mong ibigay na hindi bukas, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、自分で包み直すのではなく、元の包装のまま六人へ渡せるものを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で包み直さず六つの元包装を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo, gusto kong orihinal na balot para sa anim, hindi ako muling magbabalot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling ng anim na orihinal na pakete nang hindi muling binabalot. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは一枚ずつの袋が六つ入る箱です。外箱の表示も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Anim na supot na tig-isang piraso ang nasa kahong ito. Masusuri rin ang nakasulat sa labas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それが希望に合います。枚数だけでなく六袋あることを表示で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別商品の六袋表示を確認して希望と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Iyan ang kailangan ko. Titiyakin sa nakasulat na anim na supot, hindi bilang lamang ng piraso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang anim na supot sa ibang produkto at itugma sa kailangan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この箱は四百円です。保存方法と期限も外箱をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Apat na raang yen ang kahon. Tingnan din ang pag-iimbak at petsa sa labas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予算内です。六袋の表示と保存方法を確認できたので、この箱にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 価格と保存条件確認後に六袋の箱を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pasok sa badyet. Natiyak ko ang anim na supot at pag-iimbak, kaya ito ang pipiliin ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliin ang kahong anim matapos matiyak ang presyo at pag-iimbak. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。六つの未開封の袋が入る商品として、こちらの箱を会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Dalhin ito sa bayaran bilang kahong may anim na hindi pa bukas na supot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道の確認をされますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、電話で話しながら歩いて、分岐を通り過ぎました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通話歩行で分岐を過ぎたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, naglalakad akong nakikipag-usap sa telepono at nalampasan ang sangandaan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nalampasan ang sangandaan habang naglalakad at tumatawag. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず周りの通行を妨げない場所で止まりましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huminto muna sa lugar na hindi nakahahadlang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。このまま電話を見て戻らず、広い場所へ移ってから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面を見て戻らず広い場所で止まると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sige po. Hindi ako babalik na nakatingin sa telepono; lilipat muna sa maluwag bago suriin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hihinto sa maluwag, hindi babalik na nakatingin sa pahina. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 電話を続ける必要はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族と話しています。いったん止まり、現在地を確かめてから話を終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族通話を止め現在地確認後に終えると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pamilya ang kausap ko. Hihinto muna at tatapusin ang usapan matapos matiyak ang lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hihinto at titiyakin ang lugar bago tapusin ang tawag sa pamilya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内板で位置を確認できます。どこへ戻りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Makikita ang lugar sa gabay. Saan mo gustong bumalik?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口です。電話の相手が思う場所ではなく、今見える案内板を基準に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手推測でなく現案内板で入口への道を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa pasukan. Pakituro batay sa nakikita ngayong gabay, hindi sa hinala ng kausap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humiling ng daan sa pasukan batay sa kasalukuyang gabay, hindi hula ng kausap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口までの通路をお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapakita ko ang daan sa pasukan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。歩き出す前に電話をしまい、足元と途中の表示を見て戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発前に電話をしまい足元と表示を見ると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Itatabi ko ang telepono bago lumakad at babalik nang tumitingin sa tuntungan at gabay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing itatabi ang telepono bago umalis at titingnan ang tuntungan at karatula. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通行できる経路を確認し、周囲に気を付けてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Tiyakin ang madaraanan at mag-ingat sa paligid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物が重いのですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。駅の中で台車を借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 台車借用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Maaari bang humiram ng kariton sa estasyon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang paghiram ng kariton. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用できる範囲を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titiyakin ko kung saan ito maaaring gamitin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ホームまで自由に持ち出すとは決めず、返す場所も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 利用範囲と返却を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko ipagpapalagay na malayang madadala sa plataporma; gusto ko ring itanong ang pagsasaulian.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang saklaw ng gamit at pagsasauli. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移動先はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 北口です。列車には乗りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車なしの移動先を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa hilagang labasan. Hindi ako sasakay ng tren.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pupuntahan nang walang pagsakay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係員が運搬方法を案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人なので、荷物を残して台車だけ取りに行く方法は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を残さない方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mag-isa ako, kaya ayaw kong iwan ang gamit para kunin lamang ang kariton.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humiling ng paraang hindi maiiwan ang gamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場所で担当を呼びます。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ちます。自分の荷物と北口までの移動として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: その場で荷物を管理して待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Maghihintay ako. Sarili kong gamit at paglipat sa hilagang labasan ang ikokonsulta ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Maghintay roon habang binabantayan ang gamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物はここで管理してください。担当が台車の条件と北口への運搬方法を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bantayan ang gamit dito. Ipaliliwanag ng tauhan ang kondisyon ng kariton at pagdadala sa hilagang labasan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol ba sa paglipat ng bahay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引越していません。住所の表記が変わる通知をもらいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引越しなしの表示変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi ako lumipat. Nakatanggap ako ng abiso ng pagbabago ng pagsulat ng tirahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagbabago ng pagsulat nang walang paglipat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旧表示と新表示があります。転入した日を書こうとして迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧新表示を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: May dating anyo at bago. Nalito ako nang isusulat ang araw ng paglipat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang luma at bagong anyo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ家で暮らしていることを先に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ居住場所を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakisabi munang sa parehong bahay pa rin ako nakatira.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Linawing pareho ang tinitirhan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の情報も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin din ang sariling impormasyon mo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 身分の書類はこちらです。通知の日付を移動日とは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知日と転居日を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ito ang pagkakakilanlan ko. Hindi ko ituturing ang petsa ng abiso bilang araw ng paglipat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang petsa ng abiso at paglipat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 関係先への連絡も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maaari ring ikonsulta ang pagsabi sa ibang tanggapan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行などへ何を示すか、住所変更の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 関係先向け資料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Gusto kong malaman ang gabay sa pagbabago ng tirahan at ano ang ipapakita sa bangko at iba pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang dokumento para sa kaugnay na tanggapan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 居住場所は変わらない住所表示の相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ililipat ko sa tauhan bilang pagbabago ng pagsulat ng tirahan na hindi lumipat ng tahanan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話で変えた後、私の予定表に古い日が残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 変更後の古い予定表を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Matapos baguhin sa telepono, naiwan ang lumang araw sa sarili kong kalendaryo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang lumang kalendaryo matapos baguhin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の連絡日はいつですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日です。新しい希望を出す前に登録日時を調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前の連絡時点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kahapon. Bago magbigay ng bagong hiling, pakisuri ang rehistradong oras.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin kung kailan ang dating pakikipag-ugnayan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約番号はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。自分の予定表だけで旧予約が残るとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号で現予約を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito po. Hindi ko iisiping naroon pa ang luma batay lamang sa kalendaryo ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itugma ang kasalukuyang reserbasyon gamit ang numero. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の登録は金曜の三時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Biyernes alas tres ang nakarehistro ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話の返事と同じです。元の火曜の予定を自分の表から消します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人予定表を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Katulad ng sagot sa telepono. Buburahin ko ang dating Martes sa sarili kong tala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itama ang sariling kalendaryo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回は変更しませんね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、金曜三時を保ちます。受付時刻も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約維持と受付確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo, pananatilihin ang Biyernes alas tres. Gusto ko ring matiyak ang oras ng pagtanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling na panatilihin ang reserbasyon at tiyakin ang pagtanggap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約変更はせず、金曜三時の受付案内をお渡しします。ご自身の予定表も合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Hindi babaguhin at ibibigay ang gabay sa pagtanggap sa Biyernes alas tres. Itugma rin ang sarili mong kalendaryo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たりませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車体はあります。前輪だけ無くなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車体と前輪の状態を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Naroon ang katawan. Gulong sa harap lamang ang nawawala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang katawan at kalagayan ng gulong sa harap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と気付いた時刻は。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前です。今朝七時に気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見場所と時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa harap ng estasyon. Alas siyete kaninang umaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang lugar at oras ng pagkakapansin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に全体を見たのは。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜八時です。誰が外したかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最終確認と目撃なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Alas otso kagabi. Hindi ko nakita kung sino ang nag-alis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang huling pagtitiyak at walang nakitang gumawa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 修理に出されましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いえ。家族にも確認しますが、車体をそのまま残し写真を撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修理未依頼と保存状態を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi. Tatanungin ko rin ang pamilya, pero iniwan kong ganoon ang katawan at nilitratuhan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang hiniling na pagkumpuni at naingatan ang kalagayan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 特徴と登録を伺います。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。自転車全体の紛失ではなく、前輪の状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号で部品不在を届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ito ang numero. Kalagayan ng harapang gulong ang iuulat, hindi pagkawala ng buong bisikleta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iulat ang nawawalang piyesa gamit ang numero. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 車体が残る場所、時刻、前輪の不在を記録します。現物の扱いは担当の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Itatala ang lugar ng naiwang katawan, oras at pagkawala ng harapang gulong. Sundin ang tauhan sa paghawak dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番号が一、二、四です。三頁が抜けたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 頁欠落の可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Isa, dalawa, apat ang numero. Baka wala ang ikatlong pahina.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang posibleng kulang na pahina. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の一覧はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。白紙だから不要かも自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一覧と必要性不明を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mayroon. Hindi ko alam kung maaaring alisin dahil blangko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang listahan at hindi tiyak kung kailangan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要頁は提出先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin ang kailangang pahina sa pagsusumitihan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三頁を自分で作らず、元の書類を家で調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己作成せず原資料を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ako gagawa nang sarili ng ikatlong pahina; titingnan ko ang orihinal sa bahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suriin ang orihinal nang hindi sariling gumagawa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日はまだ差し出しませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、封も閉じません。控えの頁数も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未発送で控えも確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo, hindi ko rin isasara. Muling susuriin pati bilang ng pahina ng kopya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa ipadadala at susuriin pati kopya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 揃った後に発送方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ituturo ang pagpapadala kapag kumpleto na.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要頁と宛先を確認してから、この書類一件として持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要頁確認後の発送を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Kapag tiyak na ang kailangang pahina at tirahan, dadalhin ko bilang iisang dokumentong ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing magpapadala matapos tiyakin ang kailangang pahina. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は発送を保留します。必要頁の確認と配送の相談を分けてご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipagpapaliban ngayon. Ihanda nang hiwalay ang pagtitiyak ng pahina at tanong sa paghahatid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 開設の申し込みですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中で保存しました。新しく作らず続きから確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存申込の再開を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nai-save ko sa kalagitnaan. Maaari bang ituloy ang pagsusuri nang hindi gumagawa ng bago?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling na ipagpatuloy ang naitalang aplikasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 完了の通知はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。保存を受付済みとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 完了未通知を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Wala. Hindi ko iniisip na natanggap na dahil naitala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing wala pang abiso ng pagkumpleto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人の画面を確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パスワードは読み上げず、自分で必要な画面を開きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人操作で認証情報を保つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko babasahin ang password; ako mismo ang magbubukas ng kailangang pahina.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ikaw mismo ang gumalaw habang iniingatan ang lihim na pagpapatunay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所に変更はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入力後に部屋番号が分かりました。送る前に正しく直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未送信住所を訂正したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nalaman ko ang numero ng kuwarto pagkatapos maglagay. Gusto kong itama bago ipadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais itama ang hindi pa naipadalang tirahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再開方法を担当が案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存分の状態を確認し、重複申込を作らず見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重複申込を避け確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Titiyakin ko ang naitalang kalagayan at rerepasuhin nang hindi gumagawa ng dobleng aplikasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Suriin habang iniiwasan ang dobleng aplikasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未送信の保存申込として確認します。本人操作で住所を見直してから進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Susuriin bilang naitalang hindi pa naipadala. Ikaw mismo ang magwasto ng tirahan bago magpatuloy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: りんごと梨を一袋に入れました。別の価格ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混合した異価格商品を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pinagsama ko ang mansanas at peras sa isang supot. Magkaiba pala ang presyo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipahayag ang pinaghalong produktong magkaiba ang presyo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 安い方の値札を全部に使わず、二種類の量を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 種類別計量を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Gusto kong makita ang dami ng dalawang uri, hindi gamitin ang murang presyo sa lahat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng pagtimbang ayon sa uri. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な数はそれぞれいくつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ilan ang kailangan sa bawat isa?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二個ずつです。計量後の金額で減らすか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要数と価格後の選択を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tig-dalawa. Magpapasya akong magbawas matapos makita ang halagang tinimbang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kailangan at pagpili matapos malaman ang presyo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで二袋にします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。貼るラベルも各袋に対応させます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ラベルを袋へ対応させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakiusap. Itutugma ko rin ang ididikit na etiketa sa bawat supot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itugma ang etiketa sa supot. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二袋の合計はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ito ang kabuuan ng dalawang supot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予算内です。この四個を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計確認後に購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pasok sa badyet. Pipiliin ko ang apat na ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bumili matapos matiyak ang kabuuan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 種類別の二袋と各ラベルでお持ちください。確認した合計で会計できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dalhin ang dalawang supot ayon sa uri at bawat etiketa. Makababayad sa natiyak na kabuuan.
